verdict.rationale: Factory documents event-driven triggers: assigning or @mentioning Factory on Linear or Jira issues kicks off Droid work, and Droid reviews pull requests in CI. Software Factory also references "persistent automations" and putting code review, QA and docs on "autopilot," and droid exec can be wired into CI/CD pipelines and scripts. However, no evidence shows a first-party way to author your own event-to-action rules; custom triggering appears to depend on external CI or script wiring. Missing for 10: a documented rule or trigger definition mechanism (event conditions mapped to actions), details on how persistent automations are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
